summary.text: Andy Vargas is a Democratic state representative from Haverhill who has represented the 3rd Essex District since November 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Community Development and Small Businesses and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Vargas, listed in legislative records as Andres X. Vargas, previously worked as senior marketing manager at the Lowell-based nonprofit Entrepreneurship for All (EforAll), according to Ballotpedia.
He was elected in a special election called for November 7, 2017, and assumed office on November 15, 2017.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Community Development and Small Businesses.
